newsitem.title: JAPAN: Thai Bangchak tenders to buy Feb crude -- sources.
newsitem.headline: Thai Bangchak tenders to buy Feb crude -- sources.

text.p: Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Plc's refinery has issued a tender to buy 500,000 barrels of February Middle East and 600,000 barrels of Far East light sweet crudes, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The tender closes at 6 p.m. (1100 GMT) Bangkok time on Thursday and is valid for 24 hours.
Sources said that Thailand is seeking Oman, Dubai, Murban or similar grade Gulf crudes.
Bangchak bought a high sulphur Mideast crude in a tender issued last month for January crudes.
